description:
Cast Sanitarium Skeleton by paying {B}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Sanitarium Skeleton.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sanitarium Skeleton and the Sanitarium Skeleton token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Sanitarium Skeletons die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Sanitarium Skeleton by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
